description:
Continuing our examination from last week—SDA pastor Stephen Bohr from SecretsUnsealed (@SecretsUnsealedMinistry) gave a presentation regarding some of the SDA Church's teaching regarding the end times. In part 2 we look at their claims to Michael the Archangel being Jesus, the shut door and the "close of probation," Satan as the antitypical scapegoat, and Jesus supposedly ceasing His function as mediator during the Time of Trouble—all of which show us how Adventist theology borrows concepts and ideas from the Bible, but it is to ultimately bolster their novel worldview and system that comes from outside of scripture.

Watch Part 1: https://youtube.com/live/9n1GkQ8Vigk

Is Jesus Michael the Archangel? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xS8fQuGW-h4
